As shown in Table 3, the effective diffusion coefﬁcient of solutes increases with added Co and decreases with added Ru. This result con ﬁrms the calculation results that Co promotes diffusion and Ru suppresses diffusion.
Compared to the M2 alloy, also adding Ru (M3) inhibits precipitate coarsening, while also adding Co (M6) promotes precipitate coarsening.
